Title: Government of Romania, HG no. 367/2022, consolidated form
AuditNotes: Consolidated HG 367 text accessed directly; latest consolidation listed 17 May 2024. Article 1 defines Romanian TP beneficiaries by reference to EU 2022/382 and adds national categories; the permit provisions tie validity to the EU decision period. Retain as implementation authority; later 2026 EU decision governs extension dates.

AuditNotes: Live IGI page dated 23 September 2022; directly lists Ukrainian, protected-in-Ukraine, and permanent-residence cohorts and says IGI grants/registers TP. Useful for original/national cohort explanation but predates 2026 military-obligation condition and later EU extension; update metadata to date-limit its role.

Title: Council of the European Union, Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1912, consolidated current text
AuditNotes: EUR-Lex consolidated text dated 4 August 2026 opened; in force, with 5 August corrigendum incorporated. Articles 1–3 set 4 March 2028 endpoint, 5 March 2027 application date, military-obligation rule from 5 August 2026, and continuous-same-Member-State exception for status held by 4 August 2026.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Emergency Ordinance 96/2024, Article 19
AuditNotes: Official printable form of OUG 96/2024 loaded directly. Article 19(1) allows current/former TP beneficiaries to work without employment authorization until TP ends; (2) provides work-purpose stay extension without long-stay employment visa until the Commission-set protection period expires; (3) states special declaration-based hiring case and substantive labor safeguards.

Title: Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, eVisa: Types of visa
AuditNotes: Live Romanian MFA eVisa page directly reviewed. It describes Schengen visa categories and purposes, with 31 March 2024 Schengen transition information and appeal/procedure links. It does not establish TP status conversion or pending-application rights.

Title: IGI, Family reunification
AuditNotes: Live IGI family-reunification page directly reviewed. Gives sponsor permit categories and says request is submitted to county IGI territorial unit for favorable opinion. Law 28/2024 adds simultaneous family application for first EU Blue Card applicants, absent from this page; update its current-role description and avoid treating list as exhaustive.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Law 28/2024 amending immigration legislation, including EU Blue Card rules
AuditNotes: Official Law 28/2024 opened directly; published 5 March 2024. It amends OUG 194 provisions including sponsor eligibility and simultaneous family reunification with first EU Blue Card application. Valid legislative amendment source, but not a consolidated statement of current law.

Title: IGI, Long-term residence in Romania
AuditNotes: IGI English page directly opened; content visibly dated 27 January 2022. It describes application via county IGI units, five-year residence and excludes TP beneficiaries from long-term right. A newer IGI conditions PDF dated 2024 was found as an official replacement candidate; English page should not certify 2026 route details.

Title: European Parliament and Council, Directive 2003/109/EC, consolidated text
AuditNotes: EUR-Lex consolidated Directive 2003/109 current to 12 June 2026. Official PDF confirms Article 3(2)(b) excludes residence based on TP and applications awaiting TP status from this Directive scope. This does not decide whether Romanian national law counts prior TP periods.

AuditNotes: Task 188 retrieved exact OUG 32/2026 text from official IGI PDF; published and effective 27 April 2026. Stored Portal route inaccessible. Title: ANOFM, Locuri de muncă vacante
AuditNotes: ANOFM vacancy page opened; live feed says employer-reported vacancies are updated in real time, searchable nationally/by county, with job, salary, recipient and contract filters. Supports listing availability/currentness, not a guarantee about interview/job outcomes. URL and owner-local metadata verified.

Title: ANOFM, Medierea muncii
AuditNotes: ANOFM Medierea muncii page opened. Defines mediation as connecting jobseekers/employers; county agencies must identify and publish vacancies; lists free mediation services and electronic matching, subject to jobseeker/service eligibility. Current page dated 19.11.2026. Owner RO-EMP-01 retained.

Title: ANOFM, live Mediere — Locuri de muncă portal
AuditNotes: ANOFM Mediere portal opened live; job search filters include occupation, sector, county, salary, recipient, hours, contract, work mode, education and EU-citizen eligibility; displayed live vacancies. Directly functions as active vacancy-search portal.

Title: ANOFM, Înregistrarea … altor persoane … decât șomerii; Parliament of Romania, Law 76/2002
AuditNotes: ANOFM registration page opened (dated 19.11.2026). Gives Law 76/2002 jobseeker categories and links document requirements. Supports registration conditions/document pathway; does not itself promise a job, course or placement.

Title: ANOFM, Informarea și consilierea profesională
AuditNotes: ANOFM page opened (dated 20.11.2026). Free information/counselling is available to jobseekers and covers labour-market information, profiling, job-search techniques and integration guidance. This page alone does not support all registration, mediation and training propositions.

Title: ANOFM, Programe de formare profesională la cererea angajatorilor
AuditNotes: ANOFM employer-requested training page opened. It cites Law 76/2002 art.66 and sets eligibility/registration conditions for free training, with separate routes for employed persons and employer requests. Does not promise a placement.

Title: EURES, Living and working conditions: Romania
AuditNotes: Official EURES Romania living/working page opened; current 2026 country information identifies ANOFM and other employment institutions, employment services and labour-market information. Page includes current 2026 wage information, so corroborates currentness; primary Romanian law controls.

Title: CNRED, Higher Education Studies recognition procedures
AuditNotes: CNRED Higher Education Studies page opened under the Ministry of Education. It routes Romanian, EU/family/protection and third-country applicants to distinct procedures, and separately links professional recognition. Correct Authority to Ministry of Education (CNRED), Romania; refine Title/use to academic study recognition procedures, not general occupational licensing. No URL change; SourceId stable.

AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ OUG 96/2024 opened. Article 19(1) allows defined current/former Ukraine beneficiaries to work without the foreign-employment permit until TP ends; art.19(2) provides separate work-purpose stay extension without long-stay employment visa until the EU-set TP period expires; art.19(3)-(5) contain qualification/self-declaration and aptitude/probation conditions. Owner RO-EMP-02 remains valid.

Title: Romanian Government, HG 146/2026 setting the national minimum wage
AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ HG 146/2026 opened; Government act published Monitorul Oficial 196/13.03.2026. Art.1 establishes general minimum gross basic wage from 01.07.2026: 4,325 lei/month for normal hours averaging 166.667/month, 25.949 lei/hour. Excludes bonuses/other supplements. This is the applicable general rate on 20.11.2026.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Law 319/2006 on occupational safety and health
AuditNotes: Official consolidated Law 319/2006 print form opened. Articles 6, 10–13 etc. impose occupational-safety risk assessment, worker information/training, first aid/fire/evacuation arrangements and employer measures; this source establishes workplace safety duties, not all contract/pay duties.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Law 367/2022 on social dialogue
AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ Law 367/2022 opened. Collective agreements have legal application at the relevant bargaining level and statutory scope; they do not arise automatically for every worker. Article 100 sets who is covered by agreements at sector/unit levels and conditions/exceptions, including specified SME exception.

Title: Romanian Labour Inspectorate, petition and complaint portal
AuditNotes: Romanian Labour Inspectorate petition/complaint portal opened; accepts petitions by form, fax, email, post or at office and requires a complete address for reply. It is a complaint channel, not primary evidence of employers’ underlying duties.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Government Emergency Ordinance 96/2024, current consolidated text, especially Arts. 1, 2 and 4
AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ consolidated OUG 96/2024, owner-specific RO-HEALTH-01, opened. Articles 1–4 define covered beneficiaries/former beneficiaries and Ukraine-related package; art.4 grants basic package and curative national-program services like insured Romanians without CASS, outpatient medicine personal contribution or copay. Art.2(2)(b) provides emergency care/qualified first aid only to the specified first-entry group while staying in temporary camps. Shared URL group with other owner rows is not a removal reason.

Title: National Health Insurance House (CNAS), Ghidul Ucraina cu OUG 96 actualizat 07 feb 2025
AuditNotes: CNAS Ukraine healthcare guide opened (January 2025 edition; uploaded/updated 07.02.2025). It details basic package services and says first-time service providers register the patient in the CNAS app and issue an identifier document; scope is the OUG 96 route, not universal health-insurance proof. Later legal changes mean retain as date-limited operational guidance and update/verify against current OUG 96/CNAS instructions. No replacement source created.

Title: CNAS, Manual aplicație Ucraina — versiune revizuită
AuditNotes: CNAS Ukraine application manual opened (March 2024 revised edition), 8 pages. It is an operator-side technical guide requiring SIUI credentials/digital signature and describes temporary identifier generation for specific no-CNP/patient cases. It is not patient-facing universal proof. Date-limit the role and verify against later CNAS instructions; no URL change.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Law 95/2006 on health reform, current consolidated text, including Art. 221
AuditNotes: Current consolidated Law 95/2006 print form opened. Article 224 enumerates ordinary insured categories without contribution; the TP-specific no-CASS package is in OUG 96. Useful boundary for ordinary insured status and service package, but no direct source-claim binding was assigned in this batch.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, OUG 34/2008 on the National Unique System for Emergency Calls, current consolidated text
AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ consolidated OUG 34/2008 opened; latest displayed consolidation 26.05.2023. Article 1 establishes 112 emergency call intake/routing and response; Article 3 defines the unique emergency number/service. It does not establish ordinary-care entitlements/payment.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, Emergency Ordinance (OUG) 29/2026
AuditNotes: Portal Legislativ OUG 29/2026 opened (Government act of 16.04.2026). Article I repeals OUG 156/2024 Article LXX (agricultural/food sector rate), while it does not repeal Article LXIX construction rate. Relevant currentness cross-check: as of 20.11.2026 general minimum and construction minimum coexist; no special agricultural/food minimum remains under that provision.

Title: National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF), current Tax Code
AuditNotes: Official ANAF Tax Code page opened; it identifies last update Law 204/2026 and implementing norms update HG 602/2025. Articles 155–157/168 govern CASS on covered salary income and employer withholding subject to statutory exemptions. Supports “may be due” on taxable/covered salary income, not a universal liability for every Ukraine-related beneficiary.

Title: EURES / European Labour Authority, Create your Europass CV
AuditNotes: Official EURES Europass CV page opened. Explains Europass profile/CV creation and sharing with EURES/employers; supports creating a profile, but does not by itself establish that EURES is a vacancy-search portal or that applying guarantees/does not guarantee an interview/job.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, OUG 156/2024, Article LXIX — construction minimum wage
AuditNotes: Stored Portal DetaliiDocumentAfis/293109 timed out; official ANAF-hosted exact OUG 156/2024 PDF opened: https://static.anaf.ro/static/10/Anaf/legislatie/OUG_156_2024.pdf. Article LXIX(1), effective 01.01.2025, sets construction-sector minimum gross basic wage at 4,582 lei/month for 165.334 normal hours/month, averaging 27.714 lei/hour, excluding allowances/bonuses. Article LXX’s 4,050 agri/food rate was repealed by OUG 29/2026; LXIX remains in force. Update URL/CanonicalURL to official ANAF PDF; UUIDv5 canonical URL input means SOURCE_ID_REGEN_REQUIRED_LATER.

Title: Romanian Government, Emergency Ordinance (OUG) 96/2024, current consolidated printable form
AuditNotes: OUG 96/2024 official consolidated text opened. Arts. 1–3 define the new-beneficiary cohort, first-response temporary accommodation camps, lump-sum accommodation support for one three-month period from entry, designated local-authority locations, exclusions and responsible emergency authorities. Art. 26 is a separate transition rule for earlier beneficiaries and does not create an ongoing general housing entitlement. Owner-specific RO-HOUSING role is valid despite shared instrument. No metadata change.

Title: Romanian Government, HG 1178/2024, current consolidated implementation rules
AuditNotes: Portal record /295453 returned 502 in this access session; opened the official-gazette text of HG 1178/2024 and corroborating current IGSU programme information. HG sets 750 lei/month for a single person and 2,000 lei/month for a family, eligibility and application mechanisms, three-month limit, designated accommodation site capacity, monthly applications and conditions for months two/three. Amendments in 2025 are reflected in the available consolidated text. No blocker: underlying instrument and official administrative implementation were verified. Preserve Portal URL; no canonical change.

Title: Parliament of Romania, Housing Law 114/1996, consolidated text
AuditNotes: Portal link /70658 returned 502; inspected current reproduced statutory text and official municipal-hosted law text. Housing Law 114/1996 art. 21 defines residential letting by written agreement between owner and tenant, contract content, term and obligations; arts. 22–25 address contract duration, party rights and termination. It does not create a TP-specific housing entitlement or residence-registration rule. Source remains relevant to private rental. No metadata change.

Title: National Agency for Fiscal Administration (ANAF), Order 161/2025 amending the rental-contract registration procedure
AuditNotes: Opened official ANAF Order 161/2025 PDF, published 6 February 2025. It amends the registration procedure for lease contracts: taxpayers receiving income from personal-property letting (subject to stated exceptions) register the contract and modifications within 30 days with the competent tax body; where co-owned, the designated owner/usufructuary/legal holder performs registration. This is a tax filing duty of qualifying lessor, not tenant residence registration. URL and owner metadata verified.

Title: Government of Romania / Portal Legislativ, Emergency Ordinance no. 96/2024, consolidated text
AuditNotes: Opened current consolidated OUG 96/2024 official text. Arts. 7–11 cover a defined group of minors from Ukraine, including minors with temporary-protection permits under the EU decision and those receiving Romanian humanitarian support; art. 7 excludes asylum/international-protection applicants/beneficiaries in its stated scope. Arts. 8–11 provide enrolment, school integration and inspectorate-level coordination/placement, with distinct decision role for unaccompanied minors. Owner-specific education role is valid despite shared URL.

Title: Ministry of Education / Portal Legislativ, Ministerial Order no. 5679/2024 and annexed procedures
AuditNotes: Opened Order 5679/2024 and its linked official Portal procedure /286548. The inspectorate-level committee receives audient/enrolment requests, reviews them within up to five working days, decides placement institutions, communicates its decisions and monitors integration. It is a placement decision/coordination body, not merely a contact point. Procedure is for preschoolers/pupils from Ukraine in specified exceptional circumstances; forms may be submitted by parent/legal representative, adult pupil, or competent representative for unaccompanied minors. No universal admissions checklist.

Title: Ministry of Education, Order no. 5726/2024 — Pre-university School Regulation (ROFUIP)
AuditNotes: Official Ministry PDF of Order 5726/2024 (ROFUIP) opened. It is the original framework regulation, effective from school year 2024–25; subsequent amendments include 2025 changes to foreign-pupil recognition/placement provisions. Retain the original act for provisions unchanged in the relevant scope, but update metadata/use to flag that current school enrolment and Romanian-language rules must be read with the current consolidated ROFUIP source 8ae492b9… and later amendments. No URL changed.

Title: Ministry of Education / Portal Legislativ, Order no. 6129/2022 — adult Romanian initiation courses
AuditNotes: Official Ministry Order 6129/2022 PDF opened. It establishes adult Romanian initiation-course methodology and fee handling for adults with international protection or residence rights and EU/EEA/Swiss citizens; free manuals for specified protection beneficiaries do not establish universally free tuition for all temporary-protection holders. The course methodology remains relevant, while course/evaluation amounts were separately set in 2026 by Order 4649/2026 (source 1244a27d…). Update metadata/use to state this instrument is read with current fee order; URL unchanged. Task-184 legacy candidate resolved as CURRENT/UPDATE.

Title: Ministry of Education and Research, Order no. 4649/2026 on fees for adult Romanian-language initiation/evaluation
AuditNotes: Opened official Ministry Order 4649/2026 PDF, dated 12 August 2026. It sets 5,217 lei for course plus language evaluation and 522 lei for evaluation alone for adults with residence rights and EU/EEA/Swiss citizens; it is not a pupil-language support instrument and the fee cohort must not be generalized to all TP beneficiaries. Current for 2026 fee propositions; URL and metadata verified.

Title: Parliament of Romania / Portal Legislativ, Higher Education Law no. 199/2023, current text
AuditNotes: Portal Law 199/2023 link timed out in this session; official text was checked via the Ministry admission framework and official Portal source family. Higher Education Law governs university autonomy, recognition and admission frameworks; it does not itself prove a TP-specific free tuition guarantee. Current legal framework; annual admission rules and places need year-specific materials. No metadata change.

Title: Ministry of Education, Order no. 3693/2024 — national higher-education admission framework
AuditNotes: Opened official Ministry Order 3693/2024 PDF. It governs the national higher-education admission framework: universities establish and publish institution-specific admission rules, offer, criteria, application documents and calendars; institutions conduct admission competitions within approved capacity. It is a general framework, not a TP-specific funding entitlement, and annual/academic-year capacity details change.

Title: Ministry of Education / Portal Legislativ, Order no. 5655/2024 — admission of foreign citizens on fee-paying places
AuditNotes: Opened official Portal methodology under Order 5655/2024. It governs admission of foreign citizens to fee-paying places in foreign currency, sets eligibility and institution-specific selection rules, and is limited to its stated foreign-citizen/fee-paying track; it is not direct evidence of the status or tuition treatment of temporary-protection beneficiaries. Current for its defined route.

Title: Romanian Ministry of Education / Portal Legislativ, current consolidated Pre-university School Regulation (ROFUIP)
AuditNotes: Opened official consolidated ROFUIP Portal text (current through amendments displayed in 2025). Art. 125 covers foreign pupils without documents, audient placement, study equivalence, and Romanian initiation courses for foreign pupils who do not know Romanian; it gives no universal exact lesson-hour guarantee. Relevant consolidated companion to the 2024 Ministry PDF and the 2025 amendment.

Title: Romanian Legislative Portal, OUG 100/2022 — annual state-funded higher-education places measure
AuditNotes: Opened official Portal OUG 100/2022 and its annexed National Measures Plan. Art. 1(3) applies the plan during temporary protection and extensions; annex measure 13.2.2 directs annual state-funded university places for displaced persons from Ukraine who are beneficiaries of temporary protection and wish to continue studies. Separate measure 13.2.1’s 20% additional capacity is expressly limited to academic years 2021–22 and 2022–23 and must not be carried forward. Annual allocation does not state a personal admission or funded-seat guarantee. No metadata change.
